arxiv-1912-11055.title: Machine Learning amplitudes for faster event generation Preprint: DESY 19-232
arxiv-1912-11055.creator: Fady Bishara, Marc Montull
arxiv-1912-11055.description: Abstract We propose to replace the exact amplitudes used in MC event generators for trained Machine Learning regressors, with the aim of speeding up the evaluation of slow amplitudes. As a proof of concept, we study the process g ​ g → Z ​ Z gg\to ZZ whose LO amplitude is loop induced.

arxiv-2007-08389.title: Device-Robust Acoustic Scene Classification Based on Two-Stage Categorization And Data Augmentation
arxiv-2007-08389.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . In this technical report, we present a joint effort of four groups, namely GT, USTC, Tencent, and UKE, to tackle Task 1 - Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC) in the DCASE 2020 Challenge. Task 1 comprises two different sub-tasks: (i) Task 1a focuses on ASC of audio signals recorded with multiple (real and simulated) devices into ten different fine-grained classes, and (ii) Task 1b concerns with classification of data into three higher-level classes using low-complexity solutions.

arxiv-2105-13607.title: Alleviating the Knowledge-Language Inconsistency: A Study for Deep Commonsense Knowledge
arxiv-2105-13607.creator: Yi Zhang, Lei Li, Yunfang Wu, Qi Su, Xu Sun
arxiv-2105-13607.description: Abstract Knowledge facts are typically represented by relational triples, while we observe that some commonsense facts are represented by the triples whose forms are inconsistent with the expression of language. This inconsistency puts forward a challenge for pre-trained language models to deal with these commonsense knowledge facts.

arxiv-2402-08490.title: Ground state energy of dense gases of strongly interacting fermions
arxiv-2402-08490.creator: Søren Fournais, Błażej Ruba, Jan Philip Solovej
arxiv-2402-08490.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Søren Fournais, Błażej Ruba, Jan Philip Solovej. We study the ground state energy of a gas of N N fermions confined to a unit box in d d dimensions. The particles interact through a 2-body potential with strength scaled in an N N -dependent way as N − α ​ v N^{-\alpha}v , where α ∈ ℝ \alpha\in\mathbb{R} and v v is a function of positive type satisfying a mild regularity assumption.

arxiv-2405-08109.title: Sequence Dependence of Critical Properties for 2-letter Chains
arxiv-2405-08109.creator: Athanassios Z. Panagiotopoulos
arxiv-2405-08109.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Athanassios Z. Panagiotopoulos. Histogram-reweighting grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations are used to obtain the critical properties of lattice chains composed of solvophilic and solvophobic monomers. The model is a modification of one proposed by Larson et al. 83, 2411 (1985)], lowering the “contrast” between beads of different type to prevent aggregation into finite-size micelles that would mask true phase separation between bulk high- and low-density phases. Oligomeric chains of length between 5 and 24 beads are studied.

arxiv-2406-04713.title: FlowMM: Generating Materials with Riemannian Flow Matching
arxiv-2406-04713.creator: Benjamin Kurt Miller, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Anuroop Sriram, Brandon M. Wood
arxiv-2406-04713.description: Abstract Crystalline materials are a fundamental component in next-generation technologies, yet modeling their distribution presents unique computational challenges. Of the plausible arrangements of atoms in a periodic lattice only a vanishingly small percentage are thermodynamically stable, which is a key indicator of the materials that can be experimentally realized.

arxiv-2410-10708.title: Measurement of the nonlinear diffusion of the proton beam halo at the CERN LHC Thanks: Work funded by the HL-LHC project.
arxiv-2410-10708.creator: C.E. Montanari, R.B. Appleby, A. Bazzani, M. Giovannozzi, P. Hermes, A. Poyet, S. Redaelli, G. Sterbini
arxiv-2410-10708.description: Abstract In circular particle accelerators, storage rings, or colliders, mitigating beam losses is critical to ensuring optimal performance, particularly for rings that include superconducting magnets. A thorough understanding of beam-halo dynamics is essential for this purpose. This paper presents recent results for the measurement of the nonlinear diffusion process of the beam halo at the CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC).

arxiv-2412-00541.title: Context-Based Echo State Networks with Prediction Confidence for Human-Robot Shared Control
arxiv-2412-00541.creator: Negin Amirshirzad, Mehmet Arda Eren, Erhan Oztop
arxiv-2412-00541.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel lightweight learning from demonstration (LfD) model based on reservoir computing that can learn and generate multiple movement trajectories with prediction intervals, which we call as Context-based Echo State Network with prediction confidence (CESN+).

arxiv-2412-05850.title: Cooperative SQL Generation for Segmented Databases By Using Multi-functional LLM Agents This work was supported in part by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Nos. 62272392 and U22A2025), the Key Research and Development Program of Shaanxi Province (No. 2023-YBGY-405), and Fundamental
arxiv-2412-05850.creator: Zhiguang Wu, Fengbin Zhu, Xuequn Shang, Yupei Zhang, Pan Zhou
arxiv-2412-05850.description: Abstract Text-to-SQL task aims to automatically yield SQL queries according to user text questions. To address this problem, we propose a C ooperative S QL Generation framework based on M ulti-functional A gents (CSMA) through information interaction among large language model (LLM) based agents who own part of the database schema seperately.

arxiv-2501-16792.title: Anomalous Landau levels and quantum oscillation in rotation-invariant insulators
arxiv-2501-16792.creator: Jianlong Fu, Chun Yu Weng, Hoi Chun Po
arxiv-2501-16792.description: Abstract Landau levels in certain models are known to protrude into the zero-field energy gap. These are known as anomalous Landau levels (ALLs). We study whether ALLs can lead to Fermi-surface like quantum oscillation in the absence of a zero-field Fermi surface.

arxiv-2503-09220.title: Exploring Symbolic Regression and Genetic Algorithms for Astronomical Object Classification
arxiv-2503-09220.creator: Fabio R. Llorella, José A. Cebrián
arxiv-2503-09220.description: Abstract This study explores the use of symbolic regression (SR) combined with genetic algorithms (GA) to classify astronomical objects. Using the SDSS17 dataset from Kaggle, which includes 100,000 observations of stars, galaxies, and quasars, we applied SR to 10% of the data to derive a mathematical expression capable of distinguishing these classes.

arxiv-2509-17904.title: A short note on the Massicot-Wagner method
arxiv-2509-17904.creator: Arturo Rodríguez Fanlo
arxiv-2509-17904.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arturo Rodríguez Fanlo. We provide a general abstract statement of the Massicot-Wagner method: our main result is an asymmetric version (i.e. a version for group actions) of the recursive Massicot-Wagner argument. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification
11P70, 20A15, 03C98

Introduction

The Massicot-Wagner method is a technique used in additive combinatorics and model theory to show that an approximate subgroup has a locally compact model (Lie model).

arxiv-2602-16622.title: Phase-Field Models for Particle-Stabilised Emulsions
arxiv-2602-16622.creator: Elisabeth C. Eij, Joost de Graaf, Martin F. Haase*, Jesse M. Steenhoff**
arxiv-2602-16622.description: Abstract Particle-stabilised emulsions are a cornerstone of soft matter science due to their broad application and fundamental relevance. Computer simulations provide key insights into the formation and behaviour of these emulsions, yet current methods are limited by the spatiotemporal scales accessible for study. The principal issue is that particles are resolved individually.

pmc-10747232.title: Ginkgo biloba Extract Drives Gut Flora and Microbial Metabolism Variation in a Mouse Model of Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-10747232.creator: Ting Yu, Yueyang Xing, Qi Gao, Dandan Wang, Hongzhuan Chen, Hao Wang, Yongfang Zhang, Bjoern Bauer
pmc-10747232.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative disease. Numerous investigations have demonstrated that medications that regulate the “brain–gut” axis can ameliorate disease symptoms of AD. Studies have shown that Ginkgo biloba extract (EGb) is involved in intestinal metabolism to meet the goal of illness treatment.

pmc-11671990.title: A randomized phase II study of secondary cytoreductive surgery in patients with relapsed ovarian cancer who have progressed on a PARP inhibitor as first-line maintenance therapy: the SOCCER-P study (KGOG 3067/JGOG 3036/APGOT-OV11)
pmc-11671990.creator: Hyun-Woong Cho, Hee-Seung Kim, Jeong-Yeol Park, Yoo Young Lee, Myong Cheol Lim, Sung-Jong Lee, Kyung-Jin Min, Kyung Jin Eoh, Kwang Beom Lee, Min Kyu Kim, Jae Yun Song, Seung-Hyuk Shim, Yong Il Ji, Yong-Joong Song, Suk-Joon Chang, Mi Kyung Kim, Akiko Abe, Yusuke Kobayashi, Hiroaki Kajiyama, Muneaki S
pmc-11671990.description: BackgroundAlthough two recent phase III randomized controlled trials showed survival benefits of undergoing secondary cytoreductive surgery for an initial relapse of ovarian cancer, patients who received a poly-ADP ribose polymerase inhibitor (PARPi) as the first-line maintenance treatment, which is currently the standard treatment for advanced ovarian cancer, were not included in those trials.

pmc-13227087.title: Induction Serplulimab and Chemotherapy Followed by Chemoradiotherapy for Bulky Unresectable Stage III NSCLC: A Phase II Study (SUCCEED-01)
pmc-13227087.creator: Chengxin Liu, Yang Du, Dan Han, Baosheng Li, Xiaomeng Liu, Bingjie Fan, Hongfu Sun, Chengrui Fu, Longyu Xu, Tianyuan Dai, Wei Huang
pmc-13227087.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this single‐arm phase II study of patients with non–small cell lung cancer, induction therapy with serplulimab plus chemotherapy led to an objective response rate of 77.1% after chemoradiotherapy and reduced the radiation dose needed. Introduction

Lung cancer constitutes the leading global cancer burden, with non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) accounting for approximately 85% of cases, and 20% to 35% of patients present with locally advanced stage III disease at diagnosis (1, 2).

pmc-13252036.title: Effect of Erector Spinae Plane Block Applied to Painful Herpes Zoster Patients Who Failed to Respond to Pregabalin Treatment on Immunological Marker Levels and Postherpetic Neuralgia Incidence Rate
pmc-13252036.creator: Gülçin Büyükbezirci, Numan Demiralp, Sevgi Keles, Resul Yılmaz, Şule Arıcan, Sema Tuncer Uzun, Ruhiye Reisli, İsmail Reisli
pmc-13252036.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposePostherpetic neuralgia (PHN) is one of the most debilitating complications of herpes zoster and represents a major cause of chronic neuropathic pain. Increasing evidence suggests that immune dysregulation plays a critical role in neuropathic pain development. This study aimed to investigate the effects of the erector spinae plane (ESP) block on PHN development and immunological marker levels in herpes zoster patients who did not respond to pregabalin therapy.Patients and MethodsThis prospective, controlled, single‑blind, non-randomized study included 30 patients with herpes zoster.

pmc-13297857.title: Functional Walking Capacity as a Screening Indicator for Peripheral Arterial Disease in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Development of a Clinical Risk Equation
pmc-13297857.creator: Busaba Chuatrakoon, Sothida Nantakool, Nipawan Waisayanand, Termpong Reanpang, Lalisa Wanichsuksombat, Supatcha Konghakote, Khun Phisitbuntoon, Nichakorn Jaiin, Surangsiri Rattanaphan
pmc-13297857.description: Background/Objectives: Peripheral arterial disease (PAD) is a common complication in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and is associated with substantial morbidity. Standard diagnostic tools such as the ankle–brachial index (ABI) may be limited in certain clinical settings. Therefore, simple and practical approaches for identifying individuals at increased risk of PAD are needed.

pmc-13322418.title: Autochthonous Neurocysticercosis Brain Lesions Mimicking Metastatic Disease, Spain
pmc-13322418.creator: Elena Hernández-Sánchez, Paloma Monllor, Maria Gil-Fortuño, Edelmira Guillamón
pmc-13322418.description: Autochthonous neurocysticercosis is exceptionally rare in Western Europe. We describe multiple brain lesions, initially mimicking metastases, in a 60-year-old man in Spain without travel history. We confirmed diagnosis by neuroimaging and positive serology. Our study highlights cryptic local Taenia solium cestode transmission risks and diagnostic challenges in nonendemic regions.

pmc-13583655.title: Inflammatory Mediators in the Pathway from Breastfeeding Difficulty to Postpartum Depression: A Systematic Review Following Moose Guidelines
pmc-13583655.creator: Zainab Mohammed Abdullahi, Sagiru Muhammad Abdu, Abubakar Ibrahim Bura, Rukayyat Muhammad Abdul
pmc-13583655.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Breastfeeding difficulty, particularly pain and mastitis, has been consistently associated with an increased risk of postpartum depression (PPD). Emerging evidence suggests that systemic inflammation may mediate this relationship, but the extent and consistency of this pathway remain unclear.
